nodes.label: mysqld main
nodes.desc: mysqld_main boots the server and starts the connection event loop.

nodes.label: connection manager
nodes.desc: process_new_connection accepts sockets and hands them to a connection handler.

nodes.label: classic protocol
nodes.desc: Protocol_classic::get_command reads packets and decodes the command header.

nodes.label: dispatch & parser
nodes.desc: dispatch_sql_command runs the lexer and parser, then routes to mysql_execute_command.

nodes.label: JOIN::optimize
nodes.desc: JOIN::optimize plans joins, ref/range access and order strategies.

nodes.label: iterator executor
nodes.desc: Query_expression::ExecuteIteratorQuery drives the row-iterator tree until exhaustion.

nodes.label: handler API
nodes.desc: handler::ha_index_read_map and friends are the table-engine interface.

nodes.label: ha_innobase
nodes.desc: ha_innobase::general_fetch bridges handler calls into InnoDB row access.

nodes.label: buffer pool
nodes.desc: buf_page_get_gen caches pages in memory and manages latching.

nodes.label: redo log
nodes.desc: log_writer_write_buffer flushes the redo log buffer to durable disk files.

nodes.label: binary log
nodes.desc: MYSQL_BIN_LOG::ordered_commit runs three-stage group commit with GTIDs.

nodes.label: replica threads
nodes.desc: handle_slave_io pulls events from a source; handle_slave_sql applies them.
